title: Let's Get You Adoption Ready!
subtitle: Interactive Adoption Readiness Checklist aligned with UK Rescue Standards
description: Complete this checklist to verify that your habitat meets the adoption criteria of India's Hamster Rescue, Bright Horizon, Fable's, and other ethical UK hamster rescues.

items.label: Continuous Floor Space
items.requirement: Minimum 100 x 50 cm (5,000 cm² unbroken floor space).
items.explanation: Levels, platforms, and connected tubes DO NOT count toward the 5,000 cm² minimum.

items.label: Barless or Safe Bar Spacing
items.requirement: Barless enclosure (glass/acrylic/DIY wood) preferred, or barred with <=1cm spacing for Syrians and <=0.5cm for dwarfs.
items.explanation: Prevents dangerous bar chewing, bar climbing fall injuries, and escapes.

items.label: Bedding Depth
items.requirement: At least 20cm (8+ inches) of safe bedding throughout the main burrow area (25-30cm+ for Syrians).
items.explanation: Hamsters are natural burrowers who create multi-chamber underground tunnels for sleeping and foraging.

items.label: Safe Substrate Material
items.requirement: Food-grade paper bedding (e.g. Fitch, Carcroft, Kaytee unscented) or kiln-dried dust-extracted Aspen.
items.explanation: STRICTLY NO fluffy bedding, cotton wool, kapok fiber, or pine/cedar sawdust (causes fatal blockages and respiratory damage).

items.label: Species-Appropriate Wheel Diameter
items.explanation: The hamster's back must remain completely flat while running to prevent spinal curvature and nerve damage.

items.label: Solid Running Track
items.requirement: Solid continuous running surface with closed rear backplate. Mounted securely on a platform.
items.explanation: STRICTLY NO wire mesh wheels, flying saucers, or hanging wheels.

items.label: A4-Sized Sand Bath
items.requirement: Large container (approx. A4 paper size, 5cm+ deep) filled with safe calcium-free sand.
items.explanation: Hamsters clean their coats with sand, never water. Roborovskis need up to 1/3 of cage floor.

items.label: Certified Safe Sand
items.requirement: Calcium-free reptile desert sand or baked and sifted children's play sand.
items.explanation: STRICTLY NO chinchilla dust, mineral dust, or calcium sand.

items.label: Multi-Texture Dig Box
items.requirement: Dedicated dig box with at least 3 distinct safe textures (e.g., coco coir, beech chips, cork granules, sphagnum moss).
items.explanation: Provides sensory enrichment and mimics natural soil layers.

items.label: Multi-Chamber Wooden Hide
items.requirement: Bottomless multi-chamber hide with removable roof lid placed directly over deep bedding.
items.explanation: Entrance holes must be >=7cm for Syrians and >=5cm for dwarfs.

items.label: At Least 3 Additional Individual Hides
items.requirement: Ceramic, terracotta, or wooden hides distributed throughout the habitat.
items.explanation: Ceramic mugs, teapots, and salt pigs provide cool shelter during warmer months.

items.label: Platforms for Heavy Items
items.requirement: All heavy objects (wheel, sand bath, ceramic dishes) supported on stilts or wooden platforms.
items.explanation: Prevents heavy items from sinking and crushing a hamster digging underneath.

items.label: Forage Sprays & Tunnels
items.requirement: Variety of sprays (flax, millet, dari, oats), reptile cork bark logs, and clutter.
items.explanation: Hamsters are prey animals who feel anxious in open spaces. Clutter provides natural security.

items.label: Species-Specific Nutrition
items.requirement: High quality species seed mix (low sugar for dwarfs) and access to fresh water bottle/bowl.
items.explanation: Pellet-free varied mix supporting natural foraging behavior.

items.label: Safe Hard-Plastic Travel Carrier
items.requirement: Sturdy pet transport carrier bedded with substrate and forage for collection day.
items.explanation: Cardboard boxes are easily chewed through during car rides.
